Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Letter of Representation
11 May 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1473
Our client: Billy Jones
Date of loss: 8 Apr 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision at the
intersection referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and
is now receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all furhter
communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client
directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.
Within the next fifteen days, please provide a written statement of the bodily injury
liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with the
declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that
you confirm the insured's contact information so that we may serve any further notice
required.
Please ensure that all evidence relating to this loss is preserved. This includes
recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair
estimates, total loss valuations, claim notes, and any dashcam or intersection video
in your possession. Destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our
client's rights, and we expect your cooperation in keeping it intact while the claim is
evaluated.
Sincerely,
Candice Smith
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
